basic_details.post_name: Gram Panchayat Secretary (New Gram Panchayat Secretary)
basic_details.selection_process_brief: Merit-based calculation using Higher Secondary marks, higher education, computer skill test, and employment assistant experience.
basic_details.short_information: District Panchayat Bastar has announced 70 vacancies for the Gram Panchayat Secretary post. Candidates appointed to the position are on probation for 3 years, extendable up to 5 years, with a notified pay of 3500-10000 plus Grade Pay 1100. Applicants must be native residents of Bastar district for the 7 development blocks. Eligible candidates can apply offline by sending their applications through registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Bastar, Jagdalpur, on or before 16 November 2026. The selection process is based on Higher Secondary marks weightage,

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years complete and maximum 40 years as of 01-01-2026 (with admissible relaxations).
age_limit.details: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years complete and not more than 40 years of age as of 01-01-2026. Age relaxations apply to local residents, women, and reserved category candidates as per state government rules, with the maximum age limit capped at 45 years for specific eligible government service personnel as stated in the guidelines.

qualification.education_qualification: Higher Secondary School Certificate examination passed with a one-year diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming from a recognized institution.
qualification.details: Must be a native resident of Bastar district across the 7 development blocks. Must possess an active employment exchange registration certificate within Chhattisgarh. Government, semi-government, or corporation employees must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.

salary_details.gram panchayat secretary: 3500-10000 + Grade Pay 1100, with admissible dearness and other allowances determined by the state government from time to time.

selection_process: Weightage of marks obtained in Higher Secondary examination (50%). Weightage of higher educational qualifications (10% total: 5 marks for graduation
5 marks for post-graduation). Marks obtained in the computer skill test (25%). Weightage for work experience as an employment assistant (15% total: 3 marks per year
with minimum 9 months in a year).

exam_pattern.details: The selection process includes a computer skill test carrying 25 marks. Shortlisted candidates (1:10 ratio based on merit) will be called for the examination/skill test and document verification.

how_to_apply: Download the application form and official notification from the official website www.bastar.gov.in.
Fill out the application form legibly with all required personal and educational details.
Enclose self-attested copies of all educational qualification certificates, mark sheets, and self-attested copies of identity and residence proof verified by a gazetted officer or self.

Enclose experience certificates issued and countersigned by the competent authority (such as CEO or program officer) if claiming employment assistant experience, along with past engagement/termination orders.
Attach an active employment exchange registration certificate and category/domicile certificates.
Enclose two self-addressed envelopes affixed with postal stamps worth Rs. 40/- each.
Write "आवेदन ग्राम पंचायत सचिव हेतु आवेदन 2026" on the main envelope enclosing all documents.
Send the completed application packet through registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Bastar, Jagdalpur, on or before 16/11/2026 by 5:30 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date and time (16/11/2026, 5:30 PM) via postal delay will not be entertained, and the office holds no responsibility. Candidates must submit separate experience certificates in the prescribed format ("न-मांग, न-जांच"); failure to do so will result in denial of experience benefits. Appointed secretaries will remain on a 3-year probation period, extendable up to 5 years, and their performance will be regularly evaluated. Any candidate with more than two living children whose third child was born on or after 26 January 2001 is disqualified from appointment. Married candidates who have married before the legal minimum age or who have more than one living spouse are ineligible.
